focus: Angle 9: deep-loop fan-out fitness and the complete touch list
noveltyJustification: Seven findings are new builder and isolation facts, one extends the exit-status policy, and one contributes the complete per-file consumer table.
answeredQuestions: What does a deep-loop fan-out lineage builder need, and which consumers must learn the new executor kind?
ruledOut: A --model or --effort flag in the builder
Passing all DSH_* variables to the child

label: Registering cli-deepseek touches seven executor-config tables: EXECUTOR_KINDS, flag support, preventive sandbox capability, web-search policy, MCP capability, per-kind defaults, and the model allowlist with default and max pin.

The builder command is dsh --profile headless --json --permission-mode <mode> --approval-policy never --patch <route.yml> - with the prompt on stdin; a positional task would make the harness ignore stdin, and there is no model, effort, cwd or timeout flag.

Write permission is explicit: workspace-write confines writes to the spawn cwd plus --add-dir grants, read-only denies writes, danger-full-access bypasses the sandbox, an unusable backend fails SANDBOX_UNAVAILABLE, and --approval-policy never is the only correct unattended setting.

There is no turn or time budget in the headless contract; the runner timeout and artifact check are the only bound, so the lineage patch must also disable goal, goal-round-driver and plan-mode to prevent 256-round overruns and fail-closed plan reviews.
Per-lineage state isolation is DSH_HOME=<lineage>/.dsh-home in the child environment, which bootstraps a self-contained headless profile and session tree without reading ~/.dsh.

The dispatch-env filter is a strict allowlist of PATH, HOME, LANG, TMPDIR, NODE_PATH, TERM, USER, LOGNAME, __CF_USER_TEXT_ENCODING and LC_*, plus per-kind prefixes; cli-deepseek needs DSH_HOME as a key and LLMGATEWAY_/DEEPSEEK_ prefixes, never a blanket DSH_ prefix.

The recursion guard needs SPECKIT_FANOUT_LINEAGE_ID plus the kind in SPECKIT_CLI_DISPATCH_STACK; mapping the dsh binary to cli-deepseek makes a nested dsh dispatch fail closed, and dsh has no native self-invocation guard.

dsh exit status is deterministic (0 only on a completed final turn, 1 otherwise), so the runner can treat non-zero as failure but must read the --json final.reason and error event to classify provider error, denial or timeout.

The complete consumer list is 22 rows: executor-config, fanout-run, executor-audit, five unit tests, five stress-adapter files, dispatch audit and rule tests, council orchestrator and tests, three deep-mode SKILLs, six command YAMLs, three presentation files, two compiled contracts, the doctor agents-md manifest, the compiled-routing fixture and harness, eleven hub files, sibling mode tables, the advisor sync script, sk-prompt, two agents, four root docs, the trigger index, two sk-doc manifests and the fan-out feature catalog.

direction: A --model or --effort flag in the builder
reason: Headless exposes neither, so the route must be a patch and the allowlist a set of patch names.
dsh exit status is deterministic; a non-zero exit is a real failure.

direction: Passing all DSH_* variables to the child
reason: Only DSH_HOME and DSH_PERMISSION_MODE are needed; a blanket prefix leaks unrelated knobs.
